web.title: Making a voluntary disclosure for Payday Super
web.description:
# Making a voluntary disclosure for Payday Super
## How voluntary disclosure and late contributions reduce the administrative uplift amount
It can be reduced by as much as 40 percentage points if you lodge your voluntary disclosure statement less than 30 days after the QE day.

### Example: Effect of voluntary disclosure and late contributions on administrative uplift
#### Scenario 1: Juliet makes a voluntary disclosure and pays late contributions
As this is less than 30 days after the QE day, she is eligible to have her administrative uplift percentage reduced to 20% (down 40 percentage points).

web.title: What happens if you don't pay super correctly | Australian Taxation Office
web.description:
# What happens if you don't pay super correctly
## Components of the super guarantee charge
### Administrative uplift amount
- If you make a [voluntary disclosure statement](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/super-for-employers/missed-or-late-payday-super-payments/what-happens-if-you-dont-pay-super-correctly#Voluntarydisclosurestatement) before we assess you for the super guarantee charge we will reduce your administrative uplift amount by up to 40 percentage points, depending on how quickly you make the disclosure.

| Lodgment date of voluntary disclosure statement, starting on the QE day | If you have not been assessed to pay super guarantee charge in the 2 years ending on the QE day (see [note 1](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/super-for-employers/missed-or-late-payday-super-payments/what-happens-if-you-dont-pay-super-correctly#Note1)) | If you have been assessed to pay super guarantee charge in the 2 years ending on the QE day (see [note 1](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/super-for-employers/missed-or-late-payday-super-payments/what-happens-if-you-dont-pay-super-correctly#Note1)) |
|-|-|-|
| Within 30 days | 0% | 20% |
